title: Create Aesthetic C01-C02 Knowledge Assessments with Bilingual Consultation Scenarios
description: Build bilingual knowledge assessments for Aesthetic C01 (body consultation) and C02 (thermal therapy) with scenario-based questions and integrated answer schemes. Each assessment includes 8-10 clinical scenario questions that map to Related Knowledge items in the NOSS CoCU, answer rubrics with 0-100 point scales, and bilingual (EN/BM) assessment language.
acceptanceCriteria: aesthetic-services/CU01/KA.md created with 8-10 bilingual scenario-based questions covering body anatomy, consultation techniques, and client assessment from C01 Related Knowledge, including detailed answer schemes with point allocations (0-100 total)

aesthetic-services/CU02/KA.md created with 8-10 bilingual scenario-based questions covering thermal therapy principles, contraindications, safety, and treatment selection from C02 Related Knowledge, including detailed answer schemes and marking rubric
Both KA files validated against NOSS extract (00-noss-extract.md) to ensure all Related Knowledge items are assessed; assessment language is consistent with existing KA files (C03, C04)
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/CU01/KA.md (content: 8-10 scenario questions with bilingual terms, answer keys, rubric)
File to create: aesthetic-services/CU02/KA.md (content: 8-10 scenario questions with bilingual terms, answer keys, rubric)
Validation: Compare question coverage against _reference/00-noss-extract.md sections [C01 Related Knowledge] and [C02 Related Knowledge]
Validation: Check bilingual term consistency against existing Aesthetic glossary file

title: Create BEV C04 Performance Assessment with Thermal System Diagnostic Scenarios
description: Build practical performance assessment for BEV C04 (thermal management systems) with 5-7 diagnostic troubleshooting scenarios that align with C04 Work Activities. Each scenario includes expected troubleshooting steps, safety checkpoints, and supervisor assessment rubric (competency levels 1-4) with bilingual terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU04/PA.md created with 5-7 thermal system diagnostic scenarios (coolant leaks, thermal sensor faults, pump failures, etc.) each mapping to specific C04 Work Activities and including step-by-step troubleshooting procedures

Each scenario includes mandatory safety checkpoints (HV isolation, PPE, tool calibration) and assessment rubric scoring competency on 1-4 scale (1=unsafe/incomplete, 4=competent with initiative); bilingual language (EN + BM terminology)
PA.md validated against C04 KK work sheets to ensure all work activities are covered; supervisor assessment rubric cross-referenced with C05 supervisory competency criteria
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU04/PA.md (content: 5-7 diagnostic scenarios with safety checklists and rubrics)
Cross-reference file: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU04/KK-*.md (map each work activity to PA scenario)
Validation: Ensure all C04 Work Activities from _reference/00-noss-extract.md [C04 Work Activities] are represented in PA scenarios
Validation: Check HV safety terminology matches C01 KP and existing safety documentation

title: Create Aesthetic Performance Assessments for C03-C04 with Treatment Quality and Safety Rubrics
description: Build practical performance assessments for Aesthetic C03 (manual body massage) and C04 (electrotherapy) with 4-5 treatment scenarios each that demonstrate technique quality, safety compliance, and client care. Each assessment includes detailed rubrics scoring treatment technique (1-4 scale), safety procedure adherence, and hygiene compliance with bilingual assessment language.
acceptanceCriteria: aesthetic-services/CU03/PA.md created with 4-5 manual massage treatment scenarios (Swedish massage, deep tissue, trigger point, etc.) that map to C03 Work Activities, including step-by-step treatment procedures, anatomical reference points, and technique quality rubric (1-4 competency scale)

aesthetic-services/CU04/PA.md created with 4-5 electrotherapy treatment scenarios (6 electrotherapy modalities from C04 KP) each mapping to Work Activities, including equipment operation steps, safety protocols, and efficacy/safety rubric with bilingual terminology (EN + BM)

Both PA files cross-validated against corresponding KK work sheets and KP theory content; assessment language and terminology consistent with existing Aesthetic assessments; hygiene and safety checkpoints aligned with C03/C04 KP requirements
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/CU03/PA.md (content: 4-5 massage treatment scenarios with technique rubrics and safety checklists)
File to create: aesthetic-services/CU04/PA.md (content: 4-5 electrotherapy scenarios with equipment operation steps and safety rubrics)
Cross-reference files: aesthetic-services/CU03/KK-*.md and aesthetic-services/CU04/KK-*.md (map work activities to PA scenarios)
Validation: Ensure C03 treatment techniques match anatomy references in C03 KP; ensure all 6 electrotherapy modalities from C04 KP are represented in C04 PA
